title: Kali Mehandi Black Henna Hair Colour

details.description: Black Rose Kali Mehandi herbal black henna hair colour with amla and shikakai. Ammonia-free, 100% grey coverage. 5 pouches of 10g.
details.usageInstructions: Mix the powder with water into a paste, apply on dry hair, leave for 30 to 60 minutes and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.

title: Kali Mehandi Shampoo Hair Colour Black

details.description: Black Rose Kali Mehandi shampoo-style hair colour in natural black. Ammonia-free and paraben-free, colours hair in about 10 minutes.
details.usageInstructions: Apply on dry hair, massage into a lather, leave for 10 minutes and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.
